title: Spanish Pan con Tomate (With Optional Burrata)
ingredients: Shredded on a cheese grater or blend it
Olive oil (lil bit like tsp per tomato)
Put it on olive oil toasted bread
instructions: Mix it with salt and olive oil (lil bit like tsp per tomato)
Put it on olive oil toasted bread with garlic
notes: Original Doc Shorthand: Tomatoes, hella riep, shredded on a cheese grater or blend it — Mix it with salt and olive oil (lil bit like tsp per tomato) — Put it on olive oil toasted bread with garlic — Optional burrata on top
